parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of summing elements of an identity matrix correctly but introduces special cases that may not be general enough.

issues.description: The changes introduce special cases for identity matrix elements and KroneckerDelta summation, which may not cover all edge cases and could lead to unexpected behavior in other scenarios.
The code introduces additional complexity with the use of KroneckerDelta, which may affect maintainability and readability.
